context: Supplier Assessment Admin - Training and Document Creation Modals

layout_and_modals.pattern: Dialog modal pattern for Add Training and Add/Publish Document

instructions_to_main_agent:
1. Convert the inline 'Create Training' card in SupplierTrainingAdmin.jsx into a Dialog pop-up modal controlled by showTrainingForm state (open when showTrainingForm is true, onOpenChange updates showTrainingForm).
2. Convert the inline 'Publish Document' card in SupplierDocumentsAdmin.jsx into a Dialog pop-up modal controlled by showAgreementForm state (open when showAgreementForm is true, onOpenChange updates showAgreementForm).
3. Maintain all existing form controls, data-testid attributes, event handlers, validation logic, assignment picker, and API submissions without breaking any test or functionality.
4. Clean up any inline page wrapper styles that previously relied on [&_[data-testid=...]]:hidden CSS selectors.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default HTML elements.
Ensure all buttons and inputs have clear data-testid attributes.
Do not use transparent header backgrounds or unstyled dropdown containers.
Maintain contrast standards (minimum WCAG AA / APCA compliant).
